record.current_timing: Formal policy: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: Formal Erez restriction is documented from the 5 September announcement to the 13 September restoration confirmation, with a 6 September punitive extension. Humanitarian and other partial access differs by source, and ordinary holiday closures overlap. WAFA’s later Monday onset conflicts with its same-day Wednesday account; NAD’s September 13 closed status has an unresolved observation cutoff. No complete operational duration or first business/training passenger is claimed.
